summary: Environment A build/test evidence for Voice Activity Detection (RMS-energy silence gating) inside WhisperSpeechEngine's inference path.
scope: RMS-energy thresholding only, chosen over noise suppression (needs a new native dependency) and acoustic echo cancellation (needs real hardware to validate) - see docs/phase-5-3-audio-vad.md's Why-this-phase-exists section.
